svg.text: CONCEPT STUDY - PROVISIONAL DIMENSIONS - DO NOT BUILD WITHOUT REVIEW
1. Dimensions in mm. Third-angle projection. General tolerances to be defined (ISO 2768-m proposed).
2. Board outlines: maker or distributor data cited in hardware/netlist.json; others are indicative envelopes.
3. Heights, connectors and positions of openings are indicative and must be measured on the chosen parts.
4. Geometry and sheets generated by cad/generate.py (build123d 0.13.0); checks run with --check.
Redline tracker and black box, board RL-MB-01 (nRF9151)
Thickness 1 - notches R4.2 at the four screws - top face at Z = 12
DETAIL B: TAMPER PLUNGER, SECTION Y = +16 / 3:1
Mounting surface pushes PL1 up: TS1 stays open. Remove the device: spring drops PL1, TS1 closes.
LID, INSIDE FACE / 0.75:1: D3.4 hole for the light pipe, no metal over ANT2
BASE WITH BT1 ON FOAM AND PL1 (BOARD REMOVED) / 0.75:1
- ANT1 at the board edge, keep-out clear of copper and parts (checked).
- ANT2 faces the polymer lid; nothing metallic above it.
- U2 near the centre of the board, held by four rigid points.
- BT1 under the board: check the antenna tuning with it in place.
- J1 and SW1 line up with the openings in the -X wall (checked).
